name: Archify
summary: Agent skill that turns ideas, plans or codebases into interactive HTML diagrams: architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow, lifecycle.
description: A coding-agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode. It reads a description or a repository and produces a standalone, explorable HTML diagram with inline SVG and dark/light themes, validating its typed JSON source. Five diagram types plus an Architecture Delta comparison for design and PR review; output exports as PNG and route/reach share cards.
contains: five diagram types: architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow, lifecycle
output: standalone interactive HTML with inline SVG and dark/light themes
reads a repository to build a source-backed system map
architecture delta comparison for design and PR review
exports: PNG clipboard images and route/reach share cards
works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode
